tools.url-encoder.metadata.description: Encode or decode URLs and query string parameters
tools.url-encoder.faqs.0.question: What is URL encoding?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.0.answer: URL encoding (also called percent-encoding) converts special characters into a format of % followed by two hexadecimal digits. For example, a space becomes %20. This is necessary to safely transmit characters in URLs.
tools.url-encoder.faqs.1.question: How do I encode a URL?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.1.answer: Paste the URL or text into the input field. Select the encode mode. The tool converts special characters into their percent-encoded equivalents.
tools.url-encoder.faqs.2.question: How do I decode a URL?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.2.answer: Paste the encoded URL into the input field. Select the decode mode. The tool converts percent-encoded characters back to their original format.
tools.url-encoder.faqs.3.question: What is the difference between component encoding and full URI encoding?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.3.answer: Component encoding (encodeURIComponent) encodes all characters except alphanumerics and -_.!~*'(). Full URI encoding (encodeURI) does not encode characters that are already valid in URLs, such as :/?#[]@.
tools.url-encoder.faqs.4.question: Why is URL encoding needed?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.4.answer: URLs can only use a subset of ASCII characters. URL encoding lets you safely include spaces, Unicode characters and special characters that could conflict with URL syntax.
tools.url-encoder.faqs.5.question: Is URL encoding safe?
tools.url-encoder.faqs.5.answer: Yes. This tool encodes and decodes URLs locally in the browser. No data is sent to any server.

tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.0.questi: What is a good interest rate for an auto loan?
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.0.answer: As of 2026, good rates for new cars with excellent credit (700+) are 4-6%, and 5-8% for used cars. Rates above 10% are typically subprime. Credit unions often offer lower rates than dealer financing.
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.1.questi: How much should I put down?
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.1.answer: An ideal down payment is 20% for new cars and 10% for used cars. A larger down payment reduces monthly payments, total interest, and the risk of being underwater on the loan (owing more than the car is worth).
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.2.answer: Longer terms (72-84 months) have lower monthly payments but significantly higher total interest costs. A 60-month loan is the sweet spot for most buyers - reasonable payments without excessive interest.
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.3.questi: Does a trade-in reduce sales tax?
tools.auto-loan-calculator.faqs.3.answer: In most US states, yes. Sales tax is calculated on the price minus the trade-in value. This calculator automatically applies that deduction.

tools.bmi-calculator.metadata.descriptio: Calculate Body Mass Index in imperial or metric units, view BMI categories and healthy weight ranges.
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.0.question: What is BMI?
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.0.answer: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a measure of body fat based on height and weight. It's calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared. BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnostic measure of body fat or health.
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.1.question: What are the BMI categories?
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.1.answer: Underweight: below 18.5. Normal weight: 18.5-24.9. Overweight: 25.0-29.9. Obese: 30.0 and above. These categories are based on World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines for adults.
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.2.question: Is BMI accurate?
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.2.answer: BMI has limitations. It can't distinguish between muscle and fat mass, so muscular people may have a "high" BMI without having high body fat. It also doesn't account for age, sex, bone density, or fat distribution. Use it as one reference point, not a complete health picture.
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.3.question: Does BMI apply to children?
tools.bmi-calculator.faqs.3.answer: For children, BMI uses age- and sex-specific percentiles rather than fixed adult categories. Pediatric BMI calculators account for normal growth patterns. This calculator is designed for adults (20+).

Compound interest is interest calculated on both the initial principal and accumulated interest. Unlike simple interest, your earnings generate their own earnings, producing exponential growth over time.
How does compounding frequency affect returns?
More frequent compounding (daily vs. annual) produces slightly higher returns because interest starts earning interest sooner. The difference is most noticeable with high rates and long time periods.
The Rule of 72 estimates how long it takes to double your money: divide 72 by the annual interest rate. At a 7% annual return, your money doubles roughly every 10.3 years (72 / 7 = 10.3).

tools.exif-viewer.faqs.0.question: What is EXIF data?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.0.answer: EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format) is metadata stored in image files. It includes camera model, settings (aperture, shutter speed, ISO), date taken, GPS coordinates, and more.
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.1.question: How do I view EXIF data?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.1.answer: Drag and drop an image onto the upload area, or click to select a file. The tool extracts and displays all available EXIF data, including camera information, settings, and location data.
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.2.question: Do all images have EXIF data?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.2.answer: No. EXIF data is typically added by digital cameras and smartphones. Images downloaded from the web or edited may have no EXIF data. Some formats (like PNG) don't support EXIF.
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.3.question: Does EXIF data include GPS location?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.3.answer: It can. Many smartphones store GPS coordinates in EXIF data if camera location permissions are enabled on your device. You can view location data with this tool.
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.4.question: Can I remove EXIF data?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.4.answer: This tool only views EXIF data, it doesn't remove it. To strip EXIF data, use a dedicated image editor or privacy tool.
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.5.question: Are images sent to a server?
tools.exif-viewer.faqs.5.answer: No. All EXIF extraction happens locally in your browser. Images are never uploaded to any server.

tools.invoice-generator.faqs.0.question: Is this invoice generator free?
tools.invoice-generator.faqs.0.answer: Yes, completely free. No signup, no watermark, no data storage, and you can generate unlimited invoices. Everything runs in your browser.
tools.invoice-generator.faqs.1.question: Are these invoices legally valid?
tools.invoice-generator.faqs.1.answer: These invoices include all standard fields businesses need to bill clients. However, legal requirements vary by jurisdiction. Consult your accountant for compliance requirements specific to your region.
tools.invoice-generator.faqs.2.question: Can I save the invoice as a PDF?
tools.invoice-generator.faqs.2.answer: Yes. Click "Print / Save PDF", then use your browser's print dialog to save as PDF. This works in all modern browsers and preserves the invoice layout.
